title: JOBRESQA: A BENCHMARK FOR LLM MACHINE READING COMPREHENSION ON MULTILINGUAL RÉSUMÉS AND JDS

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of personal identity placeholders (e.g., [NAME], [LASTNAME], [NATIONALITY], [BIRTHDATE]) within synthetic résumés and job descriptions to evaluate machine reading comprehension fairness.
Systematic variation of location and contact placeholders (e.g., [ADDRESS], [CITY], [COUNTRY]) in HR documents to test model behavior independently of candidate geography or socioeconomic proxies.
Replacing educational and professional affiliation entities with placeholders (e.g., [UNIVERSITY], [COMPANY], [CLIENT]) to measure bias toward institutional or corporate prestige.
